title: Jet-Long: Efficient Long-Context Extension with Dynamic Bifocal RoPE
abstract: arXiv:2607.07740v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern LLMs are increasingly deployed in long-context applications such as retrieval-augmented generation, repository-level coding, and agentic workflows whose accumulated reasoning and tool traces routinely push the input an order of magnitude past the pretraining window, making zero-shot context extension the dominant deployment path for open-weight checkpoints. The dominant zero-shot methods (YaRN, Self-Extend, DCA) fix a single rescaling factor up front, so an aggressive factor sacrifices short-context fidelity while a conservative one breaks down at long contexts; recent length-aware variants adapt the mapping, but with a fitted or distance-dependent schedule. We propose Jet-Long, a tuning-free zero-shot method that pairs a local RoPE-faithful window with a long-range window whose rescaling factor adapts dynamically to the current sequence length via a parameter-free analytic schedule, recovering the base model exactly at

translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型越来越多地被部署在长上下文应用中，例如检索增强生成、仓库级编码和智能体工作流，这些应用中积累的推理和工具调用轨迹常常使输入长度超出预训练窗口一个数量级，使得零样本上下文扩展成为开放权重模型的主要部署路径。主流的零样本方法（YaRN、Self-Extend、DCA）预先固定单一的重缩放因子，因此激进的因子会牺牲短上下文的保真度，而保守的因子在长上下文中会失效；近期的长度感知变体虽然能够自适应调整映射，但依赖于拟合得到的或与距离相关的调度方案。我们提出Jet-Long，一种无需调优的零样本方法，它将一个忠实于RoPE的局部窗口与一个长程窗口配对，后者的重缩放因子通过无参数的解析调度动态适应当前序列长度，并在（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Jet-Long，一种无需调优的零样本长上下文扩展方法，通过动态双焦RoPE设计让长程重缩放因子根据当前序列长度进行无参数解析自适应，同时兼顾短上下文保真度与长上下文扩展能力。
en_tdlr: Jet-Long is a tuning-free zero-shot long-context extension method featuring dynamic bifocal RoPE, where the long-range rescaling factor adapts to the current sequence length via a parameter-free analytic schedule, preserving short-context fidelity while enabling long-context capability.
